Fires a shot that damages the target and nearby enemy vehicles.

Tactical Device. Fires a shot that damages the target and all enemy vehicles within a 35 m radius. If used at least once in a battle, the device is spent and can be resupplied for credits. If not used, no resupply is needed.

Only available during the Last Stand: Terra Nord event.

All unused devices will be removed and compensated in credits equal to 50% of their cost in the next update.

Gives a chance to deal increased damage to an enemy vehicle.
Activation chance: 50%.

Combat Ability. Gives a chance to deal increased damage to an enemy vehicle. Activates automatically with a 50% chance with a shot, ram, or other ability, for example Energy Shot. Can be used multiple times in a battle. Removed after being used at least once in a battle.

Only available during the Last Stand: Proving Ground event.

All unused abilities will be removed and compensated in credits equal to 50% of their cost in the next update.

Increases rate of fire / reloads magazine.

Tactical Device. Significantly accelerates the loading of a cyclic gun for a period of time, or instantly reloads guns with magazine reloading systems. If used at least once in a battle, the device is spent and can be resupplied for credits. If not used, no resupply is needed.

Only available during the Last Stand: Terra Nord event.

All unused devices will be removed and compensated in credits equal to 50% of their cost in the next update.
Fast Reload
Significantly accelerates the loading of a cyclic gun/shell loading for a period of time or instantly reloads the magazine.

Restores some hit points after destroying an enemy vehicle.
Activation chance: 50%.

Combat Ability. Instantly restores 500 hit points to your vehicle after destroying an enemy vehicle. Extinguishes fire, removes the stun effect, and repairs damaged modules. Activates automatically with a 50% chance in case of damage, stun, or critically damaged modules. Can be used multiple times in a battle. Removed after being used at least once in a battle.

Only available during the Last Stand: Proving Ground event.

All unused abilities will be removed and compensated in credits equal to 50% of their cost in the next update.
Situational Repairs

• Instantly <font color='#FEAB34'>restores 500 hit points</font> to your vehicle after destroying an enemy vehicle.
• Extinguishes fire, removes the stun effect, and repairs damaged modules.
• Activates automatically in case of damage, stun, or critically damaged modules.
• Activation chance: <font color='#E9E2BF'>50%</font>.
?empty?
Restores some hit points after destroying an enemy vehicle.
?empty?
Stops enemies from targeting your vehicle, restores hit points, repairs modules, and extinguishes fire.

Tactical Device. Stops enemies from targeting your vehicle for 10 s. Restores 32 HP per second, instantly repairs modules, extinguishes fire, removes the stun effect, and treats all injured crew members. Causing or receiving damage from an enemy vehicle (by firing, ramming, or using Tactical Devices) will reveal your position immediately. If used at least once in a battle, the device is spent and can be resupplied for credits. If not used, no resupply is needed.

Only available during the Last Stand: Terra Nord event.

All unused devices will be removed and compensated in credits equal to 50% of their cost in the next update.
Shadow Heal

Stops enemies from targeting your vehicle for 10 s. Restores 32 HP per second, instantly repairs modules, extinguishes fire, removes the stun effect, and treats all injured crew members. Causing or receiving damage from an enemy vehicle (by firing, ramming, or using Tactical Devices) will reveal your position immediately.
